name: POSITIVITY_K

name: CANARY_MARGIN
reason: a two-compartment conflict resolves only when the top compartment has at least this many more positive markers

name: CANARY_MIN_DEPTH
reason: the resolving compartment needs at least this many positive markers

name: CANARY_EXTRA_WIDTHS
source: set in Step 5 on the 7 ND images against a null (plan 2026-10-28)
reason: a marker counts toward canary depth only this many background widths above its positivity level

name: HORMONE_MARGIN
source: agent constant (Senior islet_identity.REFERENCE_MARGIN); owner 2026-10-18 asked for resolution or exclusion
reason: the top hormone names an endocrine cell only at this multiple of the runner-up

name: MIN_CELLS_FOR_RATE
reason: a check rate is computed only when its denominator holds at least this many cells

name: OBJECT_ENRICHMENT_MIN
reason: a structure or endocrine marker must be positive at least this many times as often inside its objects as in ordinary tissue

name: CD45_AMONG_CD3E_MIN
reason: canonically every T cell is CD45+; tolerance for dim CD45 and segmentation

name: CD3E_AMONG_MYELOID_MAX
reason: canonically 0: T and myeloid markers do not co-occur; tolerance for touching cells

name: CD45_AMONG_HORMONE_MAX
reason: canonically 0: endocrine cells are CD45-; tolerance for touching cells

name: B_PAIR_OTHER_LINEAGE_MAX
reason: among CD20+CD45+ cells, CD3e+ and CD68+/CD163+ each at most this proportion

name: EPITHELIAL_IN_IMMUNE_MAX
reason: markers most cells carry: positive in at most this proportion of CD3e+ or CD68+/CD163+ cells

name: SHARED_OUT_OF_PLACE_MAX
reason: a shared marker positive in at most this proportion of cells of a compartment that cannot carry it
